record_title: No exponential Riesz bases on bounded strictly convex bodies without boundary regularity
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to strictly convex bodies in dimension at least two. It does not classify nonsmooth convex bodies with flat faces or dimension one. Ortega-Cerdà's analytic boundary criterion and standard convex-geometric facts are prior work. Recency leaves residual risk of unindexed simultaneous observations. No independent validation is asserted.
